title: AI Analysis Application
tagline: GUI desktop app for model validation & Excel export
intro: A Python GUI-based tool to validate ID models with database integration and Excel export.
summary: Enabled non-technical users to test model outputs and export results for analysis, reducing manual overhead. Cancelled in 2024-04.

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A desktop GUI tool to validate ID models and export evaluation results directly into Excel.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Simplify testing for non-technical users while ensuring consistent validation and reporting.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Developed the GUI, integrated DB connectors, implemented validation routines, and Excel export.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Streamlined evaluation workflows and reduced manual analysis overhead.
